label: Bible Study
prompt: Whoso findeth a _____ findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verse: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
note: A short, sweet proverb about marriage — finding a wife is finding a good thing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the _____ he had to her.
verse: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
note: Seven years felt like a few days to Jacob — that's what love does to a calendar.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Saul armed David with his _____, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
verse: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
note: Saul lent David his own armour and helmet — David tried walking in it and politely gave it all back.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Little children, keep yourselves from _____. Amen.
verse: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
note: John's first letter ends abruptly on this line — anything that takes God's place is an idol.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not _____: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
verse: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
note: 'All things are lawful… but not expedient' — Paul's two-part test: is it allowed, and is it actually helpful?
